```{python}
#| include: false
ROOT = Path.cwd()
if not (ROOT / "pyproject.toml").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent

ARTIFACT_DIR = ROOT / "examples" / "_artifacts" / "fremtpl2"
ARTIFACT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

SAMPLE_SIZE = 1_000_000
RANDOM_STATE = 42
CLAIM_CAP = 100_000.0
JOINED_PATH = ARTIFACT_DIR / "fremtpl2_joined_v3.parquet"
PORTFOLIO_PATH = ARTIFACT_DIR / "portfolio_v3.parquet"
AUDIT_PATH = ARTIFACT_DIR / "cleaning_audit_v1.csv"

FEATURES = [
    "driver_age",
    "vehicle_age",
    "bonus_malus",
    "density",
    "region",
    "vehicle_brand",
    "veh_power",
    "veh_gas",
    "area",
]
```

```{python}
#| include: false
def load_portfolio():
    """Fetch, join, clean, and cache the pinned freMTPL2 datasets."""
    if not JOINED_PATH.exists() or not AUDIT_PATH.exists():
        openml_cache = ARTIFACT_DIR / "openml-cache"
        frequency = fetch_openml(
            data_id=41214, as_frame=True, parser="auto", data_home=openml_cache
        )
        severity = fetch_openml(
            data_id=41215, as_frame=True, parser="auto", data_home=openml_cache
        )
        frequency_frame = frequency.frame.copy()
        severity_frame = severity.frame.copy()
        raw_claim_amount = severity_frame["ClaimAmount"].sum()
        severity_frame["ClaimAmount"] = severity_frame["ClaimAmount"].clip(upper=CLAIM_CAP)
        capped_claim_amount = severity_frame["ClaimAmount"].sum()
        claim_totals = (
            severity_frame.groupby("IDpol", observed=True, as_index=False)["ClaimAmount"]
            .sum()
        )
        joined = frequency_frame.merge(
            claim_totals, on="IDpol", how="left", validate="one_to_one"
        )
        joined["ClaimAmount"] = joined["ClaimAmount"].fillna(0.0)
        joined = joined.rename(
            columns={
                "IDpol": "policy_id",
                "Exposure": "exposure",
                "ClaimNb": "claim_count",
                "ClaimAmount": "claim_amount",
                "DrivAge": "driver_age",
                "VehAge": "vehicle_age",
                "BonusMalus": "bonus_malus",
                "Density": "density",
                "Region": "region",
                "VehBrand": "vehicle_brand",
                "VehPower": "veh_power",
                "VehGas": "veh_gas",
                "Area": "area",
            }
        )
        numeric_columns = [
            "policy_id",
            "exposure",
            "claim_count",
            "claim_amount",
            "driver_age",
            "vehicle_age",
            "bonus_malus",
            "density",
            "veh_power",
        ]
        joined[numeric_columns] = joined[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric)
        for column in ["region", "vehicle_brand", "veh_gas", "area"]:
            joined[column] = joined[column].astype("string").fillna("Missing").astype(str)
        consistent_outcomes = (
            ((joined["claim_count"] == 0) & (joined["claim_amount"] == 0))
            | ((joined["claim_count"] > 0) & (joined["claim_amount"] > 0))
        )
        rules = {
            "Joined policies before exclusions": pd.Series(True, index=joined.index),
            "Missing or duplicate policy ID": (
                joined["policy_id"].notna()
                & joined["policy_id"].duplicated(keep=False).eq(False)
            ),
            "Exposure outside (0, 1]": joined["exposure"].gt(0) & joined["exposure"].le(1),
            "Negative or missing claim count": joined["claim_count"].ge(0),
            "Negative claim amount": joined["claim_amount"].ge(0),
            "Driver age outside [18, 100]": joined["driver_age"].between(18, 100),
            "Vehicle age outside [0, 100]": joined["vehicle_age"].between(0, 100),
            "Bonus-malus outside [50, 230]": joined["bonus_malus"].between(50, 230),
            "Vehicle power outside [2, 15]": joined["veh_power"].between(2, 15),
            "Non-positive or missing density": joined["density"].gt(0),
            "Inconsistent count and amount": consistent_outcomes,
        }
        valid = pd.Series(True, index=joined.index)
        audit_rows = []
        for rule, passes in rules.items():
            passes = passes.fillna(False)
            removed = valid & ~passes
            valid &= passes
            row = {"rule": rule}
            for label, mask in [("removed", removed), ("retained", valid)]:
                row[f"{label}_policies"] = int(mask.sum())
                for column in ["exposure", "claim_count", "claim_amount"]:
                    row[f"{label}_{column}"] = joined.loc[mask, column].sum()
            audit_rows.append(row)
        audit = pd.DataFrame(audit_rows).assign(
            claim_cap=CLAIM_CAP,
            raw_severity_claim_amount=raw_claim_amount,
            capped_severity_claim_amount=capped_claim_amount,
        )
        joined = joined.loc[
            valid,
            [
                "policy_id",
                "exposure",
                "claim_count",
                "claim_amount",
                "driver_age",
                "vehicle_age",
                "bonus_malus",
                "density",
                "region",
                "vehicle_brand",
                "veh_power",
                "veh_gas",
                "area",
            ],
        ].reset_index(drop=True)
        joined["veh_power"] = (
            joined["veh_power"].astype("string").fillna("Missing").astype(str)
        )
        joined.to_parquet(JOINED_PATH, index=False)
        audit.to_csv(AUDIT_PATH, index=False)
    joined = pd.read_parquet(JOINED_PATH)
    portfolio = (
        joined.sample(
            n=min(SAMPLE_SIZE, len(joined)),
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
            replace=False,
        )
        .sort_values("policy_id")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    portfolio.to_parquet(PORTFOLIO_PATH, index=False)
    return portfolio
```

```{python}
#| include: false
def make_experiment_configs(data_path, random_state=RANDOM_STATE):
    """Base models: direct Tweedie GLM and raw/tariff GBMs on the same partition."""
    glm_config = ExperimentConfig(
        name="fremtpl2-tariff-structured",
        data_path=str(data_path),
        spec=DatasetSpec(
            target="claim_amount",
            exposure="exposure",
            claim_count="claim_count",
        ),
        features=FEATURES,
        preprocessing=PreprocessingSpec(
            binner={
                "cols": ["driver_age", "vehicle_age", "bonus_malus", "density"],
                "strategy": "tree",
                "max_bins": 8,
                "min_exposure": 1000,
                "min_claims": 50,
                "random_state": random_state,
            },
            grouper={
                "cols": ["region", "vehicle_brand", "veh_power", "veh_gas", "area"],
                "strategy": "similarity",
                "max_groups": 8,
                "min_exposure": 2000,
                "min_claims": 50,
            },
        ),
        split="random",
        test_size=0.2,
        random_state=random_state,
        models={
            "direct-tweedie-glm": ModelSpec(
                kind="glm",
                params={
                    "family": "tweedie",
                    "link": "log",
                    "tweedie_power": 1.5,
                    "alpha": 0.001,
                },
            ),
            "tweedie-lightgbm-tariff": ModelSpec(
                kind="gbm",
                params={
                    "objective": "tweedie",
                    "tweedie_variance_power": 1.5,
                    "n_estimators": 100,
                    "num_leaves": 31,
                    "learning_rate": 0.05,
                    "random_state": random_state,
                },
            ),
        },
    )
    gbm_config = ExperimentConfig(
        name="fremtpl2-raw-feature",
        data_path=str(data_path),
        spec=glm_config.spec.model_copy(),
        features=FEATURES,
        split="random",
        test_size=0.2,
        random_state=random_state,
        models={
            "tweedie-lightgbm": ModelSpec(
                kind="gbm",
                params={
                    "objective": "tweedie",
                    "tweedie_variance_power": 1.5,
                    "n_estimators": 100,
                    "num_leaves": 31,
                    "learning_rate": 0.05,
                    "random_state": random_state,
                },
            ),
        },
    )
    return glm_config, gbm_config
```

```{python}
#| include: false
def setup_mlflow_tracking(
    artifact_dir=ARTIFACT_DIR, experiment_name="azoic-fremtpl2-tutorial"
):
    """Point MLflow at the local SQLite store under the tutorial artifacts."""
    import mlflow

    tracking_database = (artifact_dir / "mlflow.db").resolve()
    tracking_uri = f"sqlite:///{tracking_database}"
    artifact_root = (artifact_dir / "mlruns").resolve()
    mlflow.set_tracking_uri(tracking_uri)
    if mlflow.get_experiment_by_name(experiment_name) is None:
        mlflow.create_experiment(
            experiment_name, artifact_location=artifact_root.as_uri()
        )
    return tracking_uri, experiment_name
```

```{python}
#| include: false
def holdout_diagnostics(y_true, w, prediction):
    """Gini, O/P, exposure-weighted Tweedie deviance, and D2 on held-out rows."""
    null_deviance = mean_tweedie_deviance(
        y_true / w,
        np.full(len(y_true), y_true.sum() / w.sum()),
        sample_weight=w,
        power=1.5,
    )
    deviance = mean_tweedie_deviance(
        y_true / w, prediction, sample_weight=w, power=1.5
    )
    return {
        "gini_test": gini(y_true, prediction, w),
        "op_ratio_test": op_ratio(y_true, prediction, w),
        "deviance_test": deviance,
        "d2_test": 1 - deviance / null_deviance,
    }
```
